title: On-Time Guarantee Weekly Rate Where Remakes Are on Record
content:
**Schedule.** For Factory Production Orders, the weekly credit rate per unit of the on-time guarantee follows the remakes on the order:

1. when a remake charge stands on the order without a waiver reversing it, the rate is **half** (50 percent) of the class credit per unit per week;
2. when no remake charge stands and at least one remake on the order has a company cause (factory defect, freight damage or company mismeasure), the rate is **1.2 times** the class credit per unit per week;
3. otherwise it is the class credit per unit per week.

## Rates by class (USD per unit per full week)

| Build class | Class credit per unit per week | Remake charge standing | Company-cause remake, no charge standing | Neither |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Custom Size Build | 25.00 | 12.50 | 30.00 | 25.00 |
| Custom Color Build | 25.00 | 12.50 | 30.00 | 25.00 |
| Specialty Glass Build | 30.00 | 15.00 | 36.00 | 30.00 |
| Specialty Shape Build | 0.00 | — | — | — |
| Impact-Rated Build | 0.00 | — | — | — |
| Architectural Wood Build | 50.00 | 25.00 | 60.00 | 50.00 |

The Specialty Shape Build and Impact-Rated Build classes carry no guarantee.

## Records read

On the order's milestone records: remake charges, waivers of remake charges (each waiver reverses one specific charge), and remake records by cause. A remake charge "stands" when no waiver reverses it.

## Hypothetical cases

- One remake charge on record and one waiver reversing it, plus a freight damage remake: no charge stands and a company-cause remake exists, so the rate is 1.2 times the class figure.
- Two remake charges on record, one of them waived: one charge stands, so the rate is half the class figure.
